title: Kissed Algerian Turkey Tagine
description: A fresh, creamy weeknight Algerian dish featuring marinated turkey in a spicy harissa sauce with low-FODMAP ingredients.
instructions: Marinate the turkey in a bowl with garlic-infused oil, ground cumin, ground cinnamon, salt, pepper, and half of the harissa paste for 30 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and sear turkey pieces until browned on all sides.
Add scallion tops to the pot and sauté until fragrant.
Stir in the remaining harissa paste and cook for 1 minute to release flavors.
Pour in chicken broth, bring to a gentle simmer, and cover.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add spinach and pour in yogurt, stirring until heated through and sauce thickens.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt if needed.
Serve hot over cauliflower rice or low-FODMAP couscous.
Garnish with fresh cilantro if desired.
